title: Display switcher, filter and Search icons match the design in every display
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "DC-01-toolbar-tech-view-light-1440.png" and "DC-01-toolbar-board-view-light-1440.png" attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and rank numbers in the pictures are sample data.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}, led by technician {Technician-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C590110 Toolbar Icons, {Work-order-1} is S10043-17801 and {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C590110 Ana.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "List" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. On the "Work Orders" page, look at the three buttons of the display switcher.
  2. Look at the icon in "Search" and the icons on "Status", "Assigned to me" and "Asset on Site".
  3. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  4. Look at the density button and the "Column Selection" button.
  5. Look at the icon in "Search" and the filter icons.
  6. Click the density button.
  7. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  8. Look at the density button.
  9. Look at the icon in "Search" and the filter icons.
  10. Click "List" in the display switcher.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: three thin outline icons side by side in a light-grey rounded track (a bulleted list, the head and shoulders of a person, a square board with three bars), the same drawings and size as in the design pictures, drawn in the same slate grey as in the pictures.
  • Step 2: a magnifier in Search; on the filters a circle of short strokes (Status), a clipboard with lines (Assigned to me) and a truck (Asset on Site), thin outlines as in the design picture.
  • Step 3: the Tech View button sits on a white raised segment, the other two look flat, and the switcher icons keep the same slate grey as in List.
  • Step 4: the density button shows three lines with an up-and-down arrow and the Column Selection button a rectangle split into three columns, thin slate outlines as in the Tech View picture.
  • Step 5: the same Search and filter icons as in List at step 2.
  • Step 6: the density menu offers "Compact", "Regular" and "Comfortable", with "Regular" marked as in use.
  • Step 7: the Board View button is now the white raised segment and the switcher icons keep the same slate grey.
  • Step 8: the density button shows a card with an up-and-down arrow, as in the Board View picture.
  • Step 9: the same Search and filter icons as in List at step 2.
  • Step 10: apart from the Search and filter icons and the display switcher, List's toolbar icons look as they do in production today.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options), SV-10049 (Story 6, Density); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 61 (16 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R9a, S2-R23, S1-R9, S6-R1 and Goals, read 16 Oct 2026. Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html" (the design pictures named in the preconditions were rendered from it), read 14 Oct 2026. Related tickets: SV-11319. Product owner answers: Chris Ward, WO Board and Tech View question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU), answers 12, 21 and 24, read 15 Oct 2026. Source-verified 16 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.19-72f4f3b (staging) on 10/16/2026, before the expected results changed on 16 Oct 2026; the changed results have not yet been checked against a build.

Until 15 Oct 2026 the PRD (version 52) left every List icon unchanged, so this case did not judge the filter icons. Chris Ward answered on 15 Oct 2026 (answer 12) that the filter chips and Search use the design file's icons in every display option, List included, and (answer 21) that today's tabs, toolbar and Create Work Order button stay. PRD versions 54 to 61 say so, and this case follows them. The design names the three options Table, By Lead Tech and Board; PRD version 61 still keeps List, Tech View and Board View (answer 24). The Technician filter's wrench icon is checked in the Technician filter design case.

PRD versions 55 and 58 (S1-R9a, S2-R23; Chris Ward rulings on Slavcho Mitrov's questions and PR notes, 15 Oct 2026) add that the display switcher's icons and the toolbar icons are the design's slate colour in every view, List included; steps 1, 3, 4 and 7 check it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R9a: “The switcher uses the design’s icons at 20px: List is Lucide `list`, Tech View is `user-round`, Board View is `square-kanban`. In Tech View and Board View these icons are the design’s: density (`row-height` in Tech View, `card-height` in Board View, custom icons in the design system’s icon set), collapse chevron (`chevron-down`), pin and unpin (`pin` / `pin-off`), Invoiced or Paid lock (`lock`), Unassigned avatar (`user-round`) and the empty state when there are no work orders at all (`clipboard-list`). The filtered no-results state is the List’s, magnifier included (S1-N1). The filter chips and Search use the design file’s icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it. The display switcher (new on every view, List included) shows the design’s slate icons in every view, so it keeps one color as the user moves between views. These are the only changes to List. Every other List icon is unchanged.”
  • S2-R23: “In Tech View and Board View, as in the design: a technician avatar without a photo is a light-grey circle (--sv-grey-100, #EEF2F6) with initials in --sv-grey-600 (#4B5565) in light mode, which meets accessible contrast (6.7:1; the design file’s #697586 is 4.2:1); dark mode uses the design’s dark colors; group and column header names are 14px, weight 600, in the design’s slate text color (#364152), with the design’s smaller, lighter initials; Board card customer and total price are weight 500; toolbar and switcher icons are the design’s slate color (the switcher in List too, S1-R9a). Technician avatars, and the Service Advisor avatar, follow density in Tech View as in the design: 20px, 24px and 32px on rows and 24px, 28px and 36px on group headers at Compact, Regular and Comfortable; Board View card avatars stay 24px. The Progress bar is 48 by 4px at Compact, as in the design. The name bubble on hover over a technician avatar on a row or card (the +N included) opens above the avatar, in both views; group and column header avatars keep the browser’s plain name tip, because the name is printed beside them. In Tech View, Status, Waiting On Parts and Progress are left-aligned. The Density and Columns tooltips open above their button, like the switcher’s (S1-R9b), and are hidden while their menu is open. List is unchanged.”
  • S1-R9: “The switcher visually indicates the active display option.”
  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View and Board View.”
  • Goals: “List remains the default and is unchanged from production. The only changes to the Work Orders page are the display switcher and the icons on the filter chips and Search, which follow the design file in every display option, List included (S1-R9a). Today’s tabs, toolbar layout and Create Work Order button stay as they are.”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), density button icon: “name: kanban ? 'card-height' : 'row-height',”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), column chooser button icon: “window.svIcon("columns-3", 20)”
  • Design — README.md (design library), icons: “Never emoji. Never a unicode glyph as an icon.”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), Work Orders filter chip Status icon: “id: "status", icon: SVIcons.ICON_LOAD, label: "Status",”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), Work Orders filter chip Assigned to me icon: “id: "mine", icon: svGlyph("clipboard-list", 16), label: "Assigned to me",”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), Work Orders filter chip Asset on site icon: “id: "asset", icon: SVIcons.ICON_TRUCK, label: "Asset on site",”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), spinner icon: “ICON_LOAD: lazyGlyph("loader"),”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), Search icon: “ICON_SEARCH: lazyGlyph("search", 20),”
